# Citation followed by a colon

The closest analog is `argmin`\ [@kroboth2025]: a framework from which this work takes considerable inspiration, including the driver loop.

See the work of others [@foo] and consider the array index expression a[b]: both markers appear, but neither opens a reference definition.

A literal `[@` in code and a separate `]:` in code must not pin the paragraph either, so this long line still reflows.
